parties: Videocon Industries Limited (debtor); Committee of Creditors
headline: Videocon Industries Ltd: 64th CoC meeting scheduled for resolution plan consideration
sum: Videocon Industries Limited issued a pre-facto intimation of its 64th Committee of Creditors meeting for 21 August 2026, signalling an advanced stage in its corporate insolvency resolution process under the IBC.
implication: Multiple CoC meetings (now at 64th iteration) signal protracted resolution negotiations; the specific meeting number is material to creditors tracking approval likelihood and potential plan modifications under the IBC's consensus-building regime.
detail: Videocon Industries, a major consumer electronics and home appliances manufacturer, remains in formal CIRP under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The pre-facto intimation filed with the NSE on 18 August 2026 announces the 64th meeting of the Committee of Creditors scheduled for Friday, 21 August 2026. This advanced meeting number indicates substantial creditor discussions and iterative negotiations on resolution parameters. The timing suggests the resolution plan framework is nearing critical approval milestones under IBC Section 30.
